outcome: Maternal morbidity (including severe perineal laceration, episiotomy, postpartum hemorrhage)
Duration of the second stage of labor
Maternal psychological status at 2 months postpartum
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies at or near term (≥35 weeks' gestation) attempting vaginal delivery
finding: While open-glottis pushing was associated with lower operative vaginal delivery rates in parous women, there was no difference in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Among parous women, open-glottis pushing was associated with a lower risk of operative vaginal delivery.
